<translate>
'''Majin Buu's House''' is [[Special:MyLanguage/Majin Buu|Majin Buu]]'s home in the plains of [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]. Buu trains anyone regardless of alignment and teaches his own techniques.
</translate>

<translate>
== Who lives here ==
</translate>
<translate>
'''[[Special:MyLanguage/Majin Buu|Majin Buu]]''' teaches Assault Rain, Gum Punch and Sleep Recovery. He has no alignment requirement.
</translate>

<translate>
== Finding it ==
</translate>
<translate>
Majin Buu's House generates once per world, in a plains biome. Every tier-5 [[Special:MyLanguage/Capsule Corp Assistant|Capsule Corp Assistant]] sells a '''Majin Buu's House Map''' for 1 Cake and an empty Map. Players with the locate permission can use {{Command|/dmzlocate buu_house}}. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures#Finding structures|Finding structures]].
</translate>

<translate>
Like every master's home, the house can't be damaged by ki attacks (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures#Protection|Protection]]).
</translate>
